entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:1
segments: I [am] the rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:2
segments: As the lily among thorns, so [is] My love among the daughters.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:3
segments: As the apple among the trees of the wood, so [is] my Beloved among the sons. I sat down under His shadow with great delight, and His fruit [was] sweet to my taste.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:4
segments: He brought me to the banqueting house, and His banner over me [was] love.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:5
segments: Feed me with raisin cakes, comfort me with apples, for I [am] sick [with] love.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:6
segments: His left hand [is] under my head, and His right hand embraces me.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:7
segments: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles, and by the does of the field, do not stir up or awake [my] Love until He please.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:8
segments: The voice of my Beloved! Behold, He comes leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:9
segments: My Beloved is like a roe or a young hart. Behold, [He] stands behind our wall, He looks forth at the windows, peering from the lattice.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:10
segments: My Beloved spoke, and said to me, Rise up, My love, My beautiful one, and come away.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:11
segments: For lo, the winter is past, the rain is over; it goes to itself.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:12
segments: the flowers appear on the earth; the time of singing has come, and the voice of the turtle-dove is heard in our land;

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:13
segments: the fig tree puts forth her green figs, and the vines [with] the tender grape give a [good] smell. Arise, My love, My beautiful one, and come away.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:14
segments: O My dove, in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs, let Me see your face, let Me hear your voice; for your voice [is] sweet, and your face [is] beautiful.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:15
segments: Take us the foxes, the little foxes that spoil the vines; for our vines [have] tender grapes.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:16
segments: My Beloved [is] mine, and I [am] His; He feeds among the lilies.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:17
segments: Until when does the day blow, and the shadows flee away? Turn, my Beloved, and be like a gazelle, or a young deer, the stag, on the mountains of Bether.
